intro: Real Madrid will look to reel in Barcelona at the top of La Liga by maintaining their current winning run against a Celta Vigo side who remain in poor form on their travels.
h2h: Real Madrid have lost just one of their last 24 La Liga H2Hs against Celta Vigo (W21, D2), winning 11 of the last 12, although that sole defeat did come in last season’s corresponding fixture.
datos: Real Madrid have scored in both halves of four of their five home league games this campaign.
Real Madrid have conceded eight of their ten La Liga goals this season in the second half.
Celta’s La Liga matches this season have averaged a league-low 1.7 goals per game.
Only one of Celta’s last six league games saw both teams score.
Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Arda Güler has nine goal contributions in his last eight games for club and country (G4, A5), with six of his last eight goals arriving before half-time. Celta's Williot Swedberg has scored more La Liga goals against Real Madrid than any other side (four), all of which came after half-time following his brace in last season’s corresponding fixture.

Aurélien Tchouaméni is doubtful for Real Madrid after pulling out of the France squad over the international break, while Miguel Román headlines Celta’s injury list that contains up to five first-teamers.
